Technologies.Name: Planetary Chart
Technologies.Subtitle: Cartographic Data
Technologies.Description:
A map of a nearby planet. A a relic of an ancient civilisation has been marked.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

Technologies.Name: Atlaspass V1
Technologies.Subtitle: Access Card
Technologies.Description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.

Provides access to low level restricted areas and outpost systems.

Technologies.Name: Atlaspass V2
Technologies.Subtitle: Access Card
Technologies.Description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
 
Provides access to mid-tier restricted areas and outpost systems.

Technologies.Name: Atlaspass V3
Technologies.Subtitle: Access Card
Technologies.Description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
 
Provides access to high level restricted areas and outpost systems.

Technologies.Name: Atlaspass V4
Technologies.Subtitle: Access Card
Technologies.Description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
 
Provides access to high level restricted areas and outpost systems.

Technologies.Name: Spawning Sac
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentient Vessel Storage Sac
Technologies.Description:
An additional storage nodule for Sentient starships. Upon hatching, the parasite inside this sac is grafted upon the vessel, exchanging the use of its cavernous innards for vital nutrients from the host.

Use FE_ALT1 to trigger growth and begin the hatching process.

Technologies.Name: Psychonic Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Pulsating Yolk Sac
Technologies.Description:
A writhing sac of genetic fluid, designed to foster the creation of new bio-infused technology for a sentient starship.

The embryo will grow into bio-technology upgrade. Begin biogenesis with FE_ALT1.

Technologies.Name: Aronium
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt.

In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.

Technologies.Name: Dirty Bronze
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.

Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Pyrite.

Technologies.Name: Herox
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Ammonia.

Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.

Technologies.Name: Lemmium
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Uranium.

Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.

Technologies.Name: Magno-gold
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Phosphorus.

Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.

Technologies.Name: Grantine
Technologies.Subtitle: Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Dioxite.

A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.

Technologies.Name: Geodesite
Technologies.Subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.

Crafted from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium.

Technologies.Name: Iridesite
Technologies.Subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal
Technologies.Description:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.

Crafted from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine.

Technologies.Name: Projectile Ammunition
Technologies.Subtitle: Universal Ammo Module
Technologies.Description:
Advanced munition fragments, constructed to fit Universal Multi-Tool Standard 07/FF1.

Easily inserted into the Boltcaster, Pulse Spitter and Scatter Blaster via the Multi-Tool clip reloading system.

Technologies.Name: Antimatter Housing
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
Secure antimatter containment device, required before Antimatter can be safely secured as Warp Cells.

Rebound Oxygen forms a protective gas pocket, preventing the antimatter from reacting with the surrounding casing.

Technologies.Name: Ship Research Station
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Starship Research Station
Technologies.Description:
This self-sufficient portable research station allows access to a range of technology upgrades.

Deploy this station within a base to begin upgrade selection process.

Technologies.Name: Exosuit Research Station
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Exosuit Research Station
Technologies.Description:
This self-sufficient portable research station allows access to a range of technology upgrades.

Deploy this station within a base to begin upgrade selection process.

Technologies.Name: Multi-tool Research Station
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Multi-Tool Research Station
Technologies.Description:
This self-sufficient portable research station allows access to a range of technology upgrades.

Deploy this station within a base to begin upgrade selection process.

Technologies.Name: Antimatter
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
Contained negative matter and baryogenesis antiparticles.
 
The vast energy potential of antimatter makes it highly valuable. 95% of existing antimatter consumption is in the powering of starship hyperdrives.

WARNING: uncontained usage is not recommended.

Technologies.Name: Any Edible Bone
Technologies.Subtitle: Ingredient Category
Technologies.Description:
A highly refined food product, created in the Nutrient Processor. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets.

Food such as this can be highly valuable.

Technologies.Name: Any Seafood
Technologies.Subtitle: Ingredient Category
Technologies.Description:
A piece of seafood, created in the Nutrient Processor. Food such as this can be highly valuable.

Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.

Technologies.Name: Any Cooked Seafood
Technologies.Subtitle: Ingredient Category
Technologies.Description:

Technologies.Name: Singularity Cortex Node
Technologies.Subtitle: Singularity Cortex Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A moderate upgrade for the Singularity Cortex. Use FE_ALT1 to trigger node growth and begin the grafting process.

Each node is genetically unique, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.

Potential improvements include: warp-drive efficiency and jump distance.

Technologies.Name: Condensed Stellar Ice
Technologies.Subtitle: Valuable Comet Fragment
Technologies.Description:
A valuable vacuum condensate harvested from the remains of a shattered comet.

This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Remembrance
Technologies.Subtitle: A relic of another place
Technologies.Description: Everything you ever knew is within.

Technologies.Name: Runic Lens
Technologies.Subtitle: Geometric Anomaly
Technologies.Description:
The geometric heart of this ancient weapon is the Runic Lens. Its impossible geometry not only concentrates light into a high-powered Mining Laser, but can also warp the local electromagnetic field so as to render the user invisible.

Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK. Select its secondary cloaking function with CYCLEALTWEAPON and hold ALTATTACK to activate.

Technologies.Name: Echinocactus
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
Native to barren biomes and capable of withstanding long periods of drought, Echinocactus is an edible succulent that responds well to cultivation, yielding a large but occasional harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Barren climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 16 hours

Technologies.Name: Base Computer
Technologies.Subtitle: Site Evaluation Device
Technologies.Description:
Portable land registration service.

When placed, contacts Universal Cartographic Archive to establish ownership of land. Successful registration allows the construction of base modules across any site of the user's choosing.

Technologies.Name: Debris Rangefinder
Technologies.Subtitle: Deep-Space Salvage Locator
Technologies.Description:
A single-use device for locating the wreckage of starships in deep space.

Select the Rangefinder and Scan for Debris (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

Technologies.Name: Amino Chamber
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A specialist biological catalysation device.

This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Consciousness Bridge
Technologies.Subtitle: Reactivated Neural Ladder
Technologies.Description:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.

This device appears to offer an interface between an individual entity and a greater shared consciousness. It appears derived from, but not attuned to, Korvax technology.

Technologies.Name: Pulsating Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Superheated Life Fragment
Technologies.Description:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.

Organic, but aglow with heat and possessing a highly-pressurised inner vessel. This 'device' is part pump, and part accelerated evolutionary chamber.

Technologies.Name: Impossible Membrane
Technologies.Subtitle: Auto-Regenerating Lifeform
Technologies.Description:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.

A fine mesh of tightly woven fibre. Micro-organisms embedded within the weave allow it to regenerate endlessly, a perfect and infinite bionic skin.

Technologies.Name: Seeds of Glass
Technologies.Subtitle: Frozen Archive
Technologies.Description:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.

Capsules of genetic material, encased in a film of living glass. Shared memories swim in the their reflective surfaces, waiting for their chance to shape the life within.

Technologies.Name: Archived Soul
Technologies.Subtitle: Bionic Ark
Technologies.Description:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.

A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.

Technologies.Name: Mature Neural Stem
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Starship Organ
Technologies.Description:
This web of living tissue has grown its own metallic filaments, a mesh of silver and flesh. It crackles with its own electric charge, a network in need of its nodes.

It awaits its host.

Technologies.Name: Mature Heart Node
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Starship Organ
Technologies.Description:
Powerful and muscular, this bionic pump sits within a network of synthetic tubes. It twitches when touched, its rhythms sensitive to the presence of other thinking entities.

It awaits its host.

Technologies.Name: Hardened Shell
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Starship Organ
Technologies.Description:
Translucent, reflective, iridescent, impossibly strong. This shell swiftly reconfigures itself upon damage, knitting itself back together stronger than ever before. The newly formed bonds create a memory in glass, reflecting back the light absorbed at the moment of damage.

It awaits its host.

Technologies.Name: Singularity Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Starship Organ
Technologies.Description:
A sensitive arrangement of neurons in a stable orbit around a miniature black hole. The mind at the heart of this bionic miracle is free from the constraints of linear time, its experience an impossible web of myriad collected lifeforms.

It awaits its host.

Technologies.Name: Fragile Neural Stem
Technologies.Subtitle: Fragment of Life
Technologies.Description:
A delicate web of living tissue, this is the spark that will ignite a new lifeform into existence.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.

Technologies.Name: Fragile Heart
Technologies.Subtitle: Fragment of Life
Technologies.Description:
Though nothing more than a cluster of cells, it is already possible to detect the soft beating of this proto-heart.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.

Technologies.Name: Fragile Shell
Technologies.Subtitle: Fragment of Life
Technologies.Description:
Translucent and impossibly thin, this shell is no more than the merest breath of glass. And yet the potential is clear, a relentless multiplicative hardening adding constantly to its strength.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.

Technologies.Name: Growing Singularity
Technologies.Subtitle: Fragile Breath
Technologies.Description:
A slow knitting together of flesh, neurons and antimatter. The way this mind experiences the universe is beyond any imagining.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.

Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
Technologies.Description:

Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

Technologies.Name: Boltcaster
Technologies.Subtitle: Energy Projectile Weapon
Technologies.Description:
Generalist weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.

The Boltcaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to supercharge Metallic Elements, firing them as high-velocity projectiles capable of causing extreme damage.

Technologies.Name: Boltcaster SM
Technologies.Subtitle: Boltcaster Companion Unit
Technologies.Description:
Boltcaster shots deliver added physical damage upon impact.

Grants additional kinetic energy to the user's ionised plasma distribution systems.

Operates automatically once constructed within user's Multi-Tool inventory.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Water
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
The water in this vessel seems to stretch on forever, plunging down to dizzying depths, far beyond what the container could possibly hold.

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1. Beware what lurks in the deep water...

Technologies.Name: Construction Research Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Technology Recovery Device
Technologies.Description:
Portable blueprint research device.

This field-deployable research module allows the user to convert old or damaged technology modules into advanced construction blueprints.

Technologies.Name: Salvaged Data
Technologies.Subtitle: Salvaged Technology
Technologies.Description:
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form.

These databanks can be spent at a Construction Research Unit and used to research new Construction Blueprints.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Left Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles, perfect for keeping hostiles in place while advancing to close range.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Right Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system - a flamethrower for extreme damage at close range.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Body
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Legs
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

Technologies.Name: Antimatter Reactor
Technologies.Subtitle: Baryogenesis Unit
Technologies.Description:
An autonomous baryogenesis reactor, this device can be left to harvest reality paradoxes and convert them into usable antimatter. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.

The resulting antimatter is safely contained, ready for use in all standard hyperspace power units.

Technologies.Name: Save Beacon
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable waypoint marker
Technologies.Description:
Once activated, beacons provide a permanent navigational waypoint, facilitating repeat visits to specific locations.

Allows user to record their progress at any time.

Technologies.Name: Atmosphere Harvester
Technologies.Subtitle: Autonomous Gas Compressor
Technologies.Description: An automated siphon unit for the collection of valuable gases. Once activated, the harvester condenses and compresses substances from the air over time. Compressed gas is then stored safely until collected.

Technologies.Name: Autonomous Mining Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable mining device
Technologies.Description: An automated harvester for the mining of resources. Once activated, the AMU extracts minerals without the need for supervision, providing a regular yield until the site is exhausted.

Technologies.Name: Automated Trap
Technologies.Subtitle: Self-Sustaining Auto Creel
Technologies.Description:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions.

Once activated, the system will lure and trap any nearby aquatic creatures and store them for later retrieval.

Technologies.Name: Signal Booster
Technologies.Subtitle: Environmental scanner
Technologies.Description:
A versatile scanner that detects nearby buildings. Can decrypt Navigation Data to pinpoint specific locations.

The Signal Booster can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation.

Technologies.Name: Galactic Trade Terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Trading terminal
Technologies.Description: A trading terminal that provides instant local access to the market for resources and commodities.

Technologies.Name: Portable Refiner
Technologies.Subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
Technologies.Description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Portable Refiner can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation. Note: the Portable Refiner requires fuel to operate.

Technologies.Name: Medium Refiner
Technologies.Subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
Technologies.Description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Medium Refiner allows two different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Medium Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.

Technologies.Name: Large Refiner
Technologies.Subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
Technologies.Description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Large Refiner allows three different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Large Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.

Technologies.Subtitle: Autophage Appearance Modification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override, granted by the Autophage to those who seek to build their own shell.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Standing Increased: Autophage
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Bytebeat Device
Technologies.Subtitle: Audio Synthesiser
Technologies.Description:
An advanced audio generator, allowing the user to synthesise complex musical arrangements.

Multiple devices may be placed in sequence or connected to lights to generate spectacular displays.

Technologies.Name: Bytebeat Switch
Technologies.Subtitle: ByteBeat Extension
Technologies.Description: A musical switching device, designed to interpret waveform signals generated by a Bytebeat Generator and output electrical impulses to connected lights and other devices.

Technologies.Name: Neutron Cannon
Technologies.Subtitle: Explosive Energy Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A high-energy weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. The Neutron Cannon energises atmospheric particles before propelling them towards hostile targets, delivering significant area damage

Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON. Charge the weapon with ATTACK, then release to unleash a volley of ionised particles.

While the cannon can deliver instantaneous single shots, longer charges will result in significant increases to the speed and volume of released particles.

Technologies.Name: Cosmic Megafauna Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

In the furthest reaches of space swim cosmic megafauna, aligning their paths with Travellers, dreaming of possible realities.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Tentacled Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Flow across the galaxy with this cape's lattice of fluttering tentacles, woven from regenerated cellulose fibres.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Geometric Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A vintage garment woven from a star silk blend, bearing a classic geometric design.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Titan Worm Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

"The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky."

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Hermetic Seal
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A high-performance carbon seal, able to withstand both the harsh interstellar environment and the rigours of intensive, high-energy industrial use.

User is advised to regularly check seal integrity after installation.

Technologies.Name: Cargo Scan Deflector
Technologies.Subtitle: Anti-Probe Countermeasures
Technologies.Description:
A specially tuned resonance jammer, designed to interfere with the remote cargo scans deployed by system authorities in the search for smuggled goods.

Deploy from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to deflect the probe. Note: jamming is not 100% effective.

Technologies.Name: Neural Shielding
Technologies.Subtitle: Hostile Probe Deflector
Technologies.Description:
A beautiful living weave of nanotubes, laced through the vessel's neural assembly. This structure can be energised as the ship deems fit, creating a field that blocks hostile cargo probes.

Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to ask that the ship might block the scan.

Technologies.Name: Metal Plating
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A lightweight metal product, heavily used in the manufacture of starship parts and deployable technology. A mainstay of the construction industries of all known primary species.

Crafted from Ferrite Dust.

Technologies.Name: Destablised Sodium
Technologies.Subtitle: Concentrated Sodium Deposit
Technologies.Description:
Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear Hazardous Material Gauntlets before handling.

Synthesised from Sodium.

Technologies.Name: Sodium Diode
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
An advanced circuit component.

The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.

Technologies.Name: Tetracobalt
Technologies.Subtitle: Concentrated Cobalt Deposit
Technologies.Description:
A novel molecular form of Cobalt, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare.

Synthesised from Ionised Cobalt.

Technologies.Name: Cobalt Mirror
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A specialist optical component.

Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

Technologies.Name: Chloroplast Membrane
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
Technologies.Description:
An infusion of cyanobacteria fills the membrane, which rests just beneath the ship's translucent dermal layer.

The membrane will recharge the Neural Assembly automatically when exposed to sunlight.

Technologies.Name: Planetary Chart (empty)
Technologies.Subtitle: Cartographic Data
Technologies.Description:
A map of a nearby planet.

The chart is barren, devoid of any lifesigns or indications of settled territory.

Technologies.Name: Sentinel Boundary Map
Technologies.Subtitle: Anomalous Planetary Location Data
Technologies.Description:
A strange, shifting map. Though hard to focus upon, this chart appears to show the location of a nearby Sentinel Pillar. Such Sentinel strongholds house many secrets...

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

Technologies.Name: Salvage Claim
Technologies.Subtitle: Deep-Space Cartographic Data
Technologies.Description:
A map to a location in deep space. A large wreck has been marked, rich with salvagable materials.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

New maps can be gained by exchanging deep-space resources with an Outpost Quartermaster.

Technologies.Name: Challenger's Invitation
Technologies.Subtitle: Arena League Invitation
Technologies.Description:
A battle invitation from a local Arena League member. The location of their Holo-Arena has been marked.

Select the invitation and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the Holo-Arena in your Exosuit display.

New invitations can be received by battling with Arena League members.

Technologies.Name: Champion's Invitation
Technologies.Subtitle: Arena League Invitation
Technologies.Description:
A battle invitation from this system's Arena League Champion. The location of their Holo-Arena has been marked.

Select the invitation and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the Holo-Arena in your Exosuit display.

New invitations can be received by battling with Arena League members.

Technologies.Name: Habitable Asteroid Chart
Technologies.Subtitle: Anomalous Cartographic Data
Technologies.Description:
A map to a location in deep space. A large, habitable asteroid has been marked.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

New maps can be gained by exchanging deep-space resources with an Outpost Quartermaster.

Technologies.Name: Artifact Chart
Technologies.Subtitle: Dig Site Cartographic Data
Technologies.Description:
A map of a nearby planet. An ancient ruined site has been marked. Excavating this site is likely to yield valuable treasures.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

Technologies.Name: Storage Container
Technologies.Subtitle: Storage unit
Technologies.Description: Spacious additional storage for inventory items.

Technologies.Name: Organic Catalyst
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.

Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon.

Technologies.Name: Semiconductor
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.

Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt.

Technologies.Name: Hot Ice
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.

Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt.

Technologies.Name: Fusion Accelerant
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.

Crafted from Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt.

Technologies.Name: Superconductor
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.

Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Semiconductors.

Technologies.Name: Cryo-pump
Technologies.Subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.

Crafted from Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate

Technologies.Name: Quantum Computer
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
An extremely fast advanced processing unit. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Sustenance Unit
Technologies.Description:
A portable nutrient extractor, able to process and refine gathered ingredients into edible food products.

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

Technologies.Name: Mordite Root
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
An inedible tuber that produces a small yield of Mordite crystals.

A peaceful alternative to the process of harvesting Mordite from the corpses of creatures. Mordite Root must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.

Approximate growing time: 8 hours

Technologies.Name: Livestock Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Automatic Harvesting Robot
Technologies.Description:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically harvest substances from creatures. Requires power.

Creatures that are ready to be harvested for milk, eggs or other specialist produce will approach the Livestock Unit and deposit their yields. The creatures are unharmed by the process.

Will harvest produce from creatures fed by hand or via an Automated Feeder.

Technologies.Name: Automated Feeder
Technologies.Subtitle: Agricultural Robot
Technologies.Description:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically supply nearby creatures with food.

When powered, will attract nearby animal life. Keep bait tanks full in order to supply lifeforms with desired food.

Technologies.Subtitle: C-Class Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A moderate upgrade for the Upgrade. Use [E] to begin upgrade installation process.

The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.

Technologies.Name: Mark of the Denier
Technologies.Subtitle: Priceless Fragment
Technologies.Description:
A tiny mote of stardust, no more than a speck. On closer examination, its surface is all crystalline shards and distorted crimson geometry.

It flickers with pent-up energy, demanding to be free.

Empower the mark as you discover systems, planets and objects across the universe.

Technologies.Name: Undamaged Drone Shell
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentinel Debris
Technologies.Description:
The shell of a Sentinel drone, all that remains after its destruction in combat. While the exterior is physically intact, its internals have been severely burned.

Given the right tools and several exotic components, it may be possible to repair it.

Technologies.Name: Nanite Filament
Technologies.Subtitle: Drone Component
Technologies.Description:
A thin, shimmering thread, once owned by Iteration: Gemini. This impossible fibre, once a treasured keepsake, sings on the wavelength of the Space Anomaly.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

Technologies.Name: Portal Phylactery
Technologies.Subtitle: Drone Component
Technologies.Description:
A vial of the portal's blue amber, given to you by Iteration: Mercury. The ether of the Atlas itself, this is primeval liquid from which it weaves the multiverse.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

Technologies.Name: Beads of Glass
Technologies.Subtitle: Drone Component
Technologies.Description:
A handful of glassy orbs, once owned by Specialist Polo. Their pearlescent surface does not reflect the world around them, offering instead a mirror to different reality.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

Technologies.Name: Life Support
Technologies.Subtitle: Suit Survival Power Pack
Technologies.Description:
The core of the Exosuit, the Life Support System continually filters and pumps breathable Oxygen.

In addition to its role in the continued existence of the Exosuit user, the Life Support Unit uses surplus oxygen to generate power for secondary systems, such as the Jetpack, Speed Augmentation and Torch.

Technologies.Name: Faulty Hologram
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.

If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

Technologies.Name: Damaged Electrode
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.

If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

Technologies.Name: Shattered Power Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description:
This Exosuit Upgrade Module is critically damaged. Repair systems to restore upgrade functionality.

If repaired, User will not be charged for any Exosuit Upgrades.

Technologies.Name: Living Water
Technologies.Subtitle: Glassy Indeterminance
Technologies.Description:
Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description.

Of unknown origin.

Technologies.Name: Icarus Fuel System
Technologies.Subtitle: Solar Recharge Unit
Technologies.Description:
The Icarus system takes advantage of existing metal panelling, upgrading them into photovoltaic surfaces. This reactive coating generates energy during daylight hours, offsetting fuel consumption.

Enables automatic engine recharging during the day.

Technologies.Name: Mineral Processing Rig
Technologies.Subtitle: Vehicle-Borne Refiner
Technologies.Description:
A large and powerful refiner unit, designed to be housed within the belly of a Colossus Exocraft.

The unit is able to process the most complex recipes, but requires its own independent fuel source.

Technologies.Name: Atlas Headshield
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A soft but immutable heartbeat resonates through your skull when you wear this helmet. A T L A S.
The pulse is strangely soothing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Atlas Flightpack
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A lightweight jetpack, welded from stellar alloys around a fiery crimson core.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Atlas Sceptre
Technologies.Subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Multi-Tool.

This unusual ceremonial staff was hand-forged by a Korvax Priest Entity in tribute to the Atlas.

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Streamlined Jetpack Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A streamlined and lightweight backpack unit, featuring an elegant single-thruster design. This exclusive exosuit augmentation commemorates completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Exotic Wingpack
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

An elegant wing-assisted jetpack, inspired by the design philosophy of exotic starships. This exclusive exosuit augmentation commemorates completion of the 'Exobiology' Expedition.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Pioneers Expedition Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.
Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Description:

Technologies.Description:

Technologies.Name: Voyagers Banner

Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Voyagers expedition, and the discoveries made along the way.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Omega Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Omega expedition, and the memories gleaned from within the Atlas.

Technologies.Description:

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Corvette Banner
