Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Corvette expedition, and the design and assembly of your own habitable starship.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Breach Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Breach expedition and the mystery of the Fireship Arcadia.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Remnant Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Remnant expedition, and the mastery of magnetism.
Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Swarm Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Swarm expedition, and survival of an existential threat.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Our Journey Continues Banner
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Outlaw Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A battle-worn cape, stolen from notorious pirate faction The Blight. Woven from chemically-dipped nano-fibres, the fabric is completely impervious to the heat produced by jetpack exhaust.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Whalestalker Cloak
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

This sweeping cloak was once worn by an ill-fated Traveller - obsessed with their quest to capture a cosmic leviathan, and doomed to repeat the chase for all eternity.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Fleet Commander's Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Master, commander, voyager of the stars. Don your cloak and prepare to take the helm.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Surveyor's Cape
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Cape
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A robust and well-made covering: waterproof, windproof and designed to keep the wearer protected against anything they may encounter while exploring unmapped worlds.
Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Whispering Companion Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Horrific Spawn
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be nightmarish and soul-consuming.

Technologies.Name: Sandworm Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Titanic Spawn
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

Curled within the shell is a hungry wormlet, its coils rippling restlessly.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be cursed and insatiable.

Technologies.Name: Quad Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentinel Spawn Capsule
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch!

The shell crackles with an electronic energy.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be tireless and watchful.

Technologies.Name: Helios Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Captured Space Protozoa
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

Floating within the shell is a haunting glow, a beacon both beautiful and cursed.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gelatinous and spectral.

Technologies.Name: Robo-warden Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch!

A regular electronic beeping can be heard from within the egg, soft and somehow reassuring.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be meticulous and dependable.

Technologies.Name: Construct 'Egg'
Technologies.Subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to deploy!

A low hum resonates from deep within the capsule, its dissonant frequency turning the air around it a faint purple.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be free-spirited and defiant.

Technologies.Name: Appalling Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Spawning Sac
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be nightmarish and soul-consuming.

Technologies.Name: Grub Cocoon
Technologies.Subtitle: Vile Larval Sac
Technologies.Description:
A writhing cocoon, the spawning sac of a grub of the vile brood.

Scans indicate the being within has anomalous genetic material, an unstable binding of several independent strands.

Technologies.Name: Glowing Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Bioluminescent Spawning Sac
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A living fire burns within the egg, the haunting pale glow of a lifeform that must provide its own light.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gelatinous and luminescent.

Technologies.Name: Fossilised Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Bone Cradle
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A foetal creature of bone grows inside, its delicate body suspended in vitellus. Its fleshless limbs are comprised of soft cartilage, which will harden and densify as it grows. 

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be skeletal and elephantine.

Technologies.Name: Mecha-mouse Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch!

A muffled squeaking can be heard from the synthetic creature inside the capsule.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be intelligent and loving, through prone to gnawing on electronics.

Technologies.Name: Diplo Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Gentle Giant Embryo
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A long-necked diplodocus embryo is inside.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gigantic and prehistoric.

Technologies.Name: Atlas Firework Pack
Technologies.Subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
Technologies.Description:
A three-variety pack of luxury fireworks. These stunning pyrotechnics render the likeness of an Atlas Interface, in bursts of indium, gold and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

Technologies.Name: Flesh Launcher Pack
Technologies.Subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
Technologies.Description:
A pack of luxury fireworks. These organic pyrotechnics rocket into the sky and explode in a splatter of slime, mucus, and wormlets. Ignite to create disgusting displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

Technologies.Name: Aquarius Flight Pack
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Jetpack
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this jetpack replacement allows for smooth and stylish passage through the murky abyss.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Ship of the Damned
Technologies.Subtitle: Cursed Frigate
Technologies.Description:
The remains of a long-abandoned frigate. Despite its ruined condition, it sails on through the stars...

Recruiting this vessel will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

Technologies.Name: Starbound V0.27
Technologies.Subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive vintage Multi-Tool.

Recovered from a forgotten archive, this Multi-Tool evokes memories of a bygone era.

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Golden First Spawn Battle Mask
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An aggressive Exosuit Appearance Override, modeled on the war helmets of the ancient Gek. This special edition is cast in a durable and precious alloy.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Void Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Curiosity
Technologies.Description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

Technologies.Name: Exotic Armour
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. Ideal for fierce-tempered companions, this stylish plate armour protects vital organs against laser and projectile fire. Ultra-soft breathable padding reduces the likelihood of companions wriggling out of the accessory.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

Technologies.Name: Mechanical Paw
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This biomechanical remnant is a constant reminder of the many and diverse forms that existence can take.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

Technologies.Name: Deep-sea Armour
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Armour
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Deep-sea Flippers
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Boots
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Deep-sea Helmet
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Lost Angler's Rig
Technologies.Subtitle: Unique Angling Device
Technologies.Description:
A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary Lost Angler.

Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

Technologies.Name: Deep-sea Leggings
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Leg Customisation
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Boundary Horror Mandibles
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Transform your appearance into that of a Boundary Horror, a fragment of what dwells beyond the tunnels of the portal network...

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Ssv Normandy Sr1
Technologies.Subtitle: Exclusive Frigate
Technologies.Description:
The SSV Normandy SR1 is a one-of-a-kind 'deep scout' frigate. This legendary ship represents peace and cooperation between races, and commemorates completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition.

Recruiting this frigate will add it to your fleet. Manage your frigate fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

Technologies.Name: Pillar of Titan
Technologies.Subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Multi-Tool.

This sturdy staff is hewn from polished stone, and yet floats in the hand as if it were no weight at all. It is a perfect companion to those who seek to make long trips across the wilderness.

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Basilisk Crown
Technologies.Subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Multi-Tool.

The skull of an ancient beast sits atop this fused pillar of bone and circuitry. Beware its gaze...

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Living Stone Hardpack
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Jetpack
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

An unusual alternative to the traditional jetpack, this flight device is sculpted from the remains of sentient rock. Magmatic gases provide the hardpack's thrust, while an anti-gravity field supports the weight of the stone, ensuring ergonomic safety for the user.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Pioneer'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Renegade'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition, and your success in tracking the renegade historical echo.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Paragon'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition, and your success in tracking the renegade historical echo.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Globemaster'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Cartographers' Expedition, and your success in documenting and then escaping from the expedition planet.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'worm Lord'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Emergence expedition.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Exobiologist'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Exobiology expedition.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'hunter of the Blight'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Blighted expedition, the glorious retrieval of ill-gotten lucre, and the discovery of a pirate secret.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Looper'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Leviathan expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Seeker'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Polestar expedition, and the completion of a long cruise aboard a capital ship.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'utopia Dignitary'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Utopia expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Construct'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Singularity expedition, and the forging of the mysterious Construct.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Intrepid'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Voyagers expedition, and the discoveries made along the way.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Starborn'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Omega expedition, and the memories gleaned from within the Atlas.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Drifter'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Adrift expedition, and to finding peace in a lonely universe.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Broodling'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating the glorious triumph Liquidators expedition, and the victory over the endless swarm.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Fisher'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating the catches, the stories, and the ones that got away while on the Aquarius expedition.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Haunted'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, marking the escape from the boundary failure that occurred during the Cursed expedition.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'surveyor of Worlds'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, marking the Titan expedition's voyage through new stars and new worlds.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Excavator'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, marking the Relics expedition's voyage through new stars and new worlds.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'Shipwright'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Corvette expedition, and the design and assembly of your own habitable starship.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Celestial'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Breach expedition and the mystery of the Fireship Arcadia.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'mag-field Expert'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Remnant expedition, and the mastery of magnetism.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'the Fragmented'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Swarm expedition, and survival of an existential threat.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Title: 'time Traveller'
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Feasting Casque
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Redistribute your facial organs and alarm other explorers by assuming the appearance of a sandworm cultist. This bio-silicone helmet is sealed against all known planetary hazards, but may feel slightly clammy to the wearer.

Ritualistically transform the head of your Vy'keen appearance at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Chitin Exoskeleton
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Armour
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this hardened carapace represents the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Chitin Spurs
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Boots
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, these feet-replacements represent the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Chitin Gauntlets
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gloves
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, these protective claws represent the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Chitin Mandibles
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this insectoid helmet represents the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Chitin Flight Pack
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Jetpack
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this jetpack replacement represents the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: KORVAX
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Standing Increased: Korvax
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Factory Override Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Research Module
Technologies.Description:
A portable data unit, compatible with most planetary fabricator facilities.

Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.

Technologies.Name: Acid
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells.

Crafted from Mordite and Fungal Mould.

Technologies.Name: Lubricant
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
A synthetic lubricant that reduces wear and prolongs the lifespan of technologies with moving parts.

Crafted from Faecium and Gamma Root.

Technologies.Name: Glass
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use.

Refined from Silicate powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a Terrain Manipulator.

Can be crafted from Frost Crystals extracted from plants on frozen worlds.

Technologies.Name: Heat Capacitor
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
A thermal regulator produced from refined organic material. It is unique in its ability to produce, dissipate and distribute heat as required.

Crafted from Solanium and Frost Crystals.

Technologies.Name: Poly Fibre
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
A connective fibre for electronics, made from an advanced synthetic polymer and capable of serving as a conduit for power and data.

Crafted from Cactus Flesh and Star Bulbs.

Technologies.Name: Unstable Gel
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch.

Crafted from Cactus Flesh.

Technologies.Name: Liquid Explosive
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment. Do not drink.

Crafted from Acid and Unstable Gel.

Technologies.Name: Living Glass
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
An advanced building material, this glass has been imbued with organic compounds that allow it to react to the environment. Microbes within the glass filter harmful light of all wavelengths and balance the atmosphere as required.

Crafted from Lubricant and Glass.

Technologies.Name: Circuit Board
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
Technologies.Description:
Stackable, semi-flexible circuit board made from a highly durable synthetic polymer.

Crafted from Heat Capacitors and Poly Fibre.

Technologies.Name: Fishing Rig
Technologies.Subtitle: Deployable Angling Device
Technologies.Description:
A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions.

Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

Technologies.Name: Exo-Skiff
Technologies.Subtitle: Deployable Fishing Platform
Technologies.Description:
A deployable static platform, allowing the user to comfortably survey the seas in any weather. As well as providing a steady and easily accessible fishing spot, the Exo-Skiff also features abundant Cold Storage, granting additional space to store your catch. 

Summon the Exo-Skiff to any suitable body of water using the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Incinerator
Technologies.Subtitle: Short-Range Fire Delivery Unit
Technologies.Description:
Specialist high temperature weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.

The Incinerator focuses internal lasers onto the naturally-occuring exhaust gases generated by the Multi-Tool. Ignition results in a highly destructive, if short range, inferno.

Technologies.Name: Nutrient Ingestor
Technologies.Subtitle: Automatic Feeding Unit
Technologies.Description:
The nutrient ingestor improves exosuit performance via the automatic portioning and processing of various cooked items.

Select Begin Ingestion to commence automatic consumption of supplied ingredients.

Technologies.Name: Cargo Bulkhead
Technologies.Subtitle: Auto-Expanding Freighter Module
Technologies.Description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of an abandoned freighter found floating in space. May also be salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply at your freighter's Upgrade Terminal.

Technologies.Name: High-gravity Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

High-energy exhaust gases rapid condense as they exit the freighter's colossal engines, collapsing into micro-singularities.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Emeril Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

The extreme heat of the freighter's engines excites this filter of Emeril salts, tinting the exhaust with a vivid green hue.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Antimatter Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

A grid of compact particle accelerators activate with heat from the freighter engines, streaking the exhaust with a dark trail of antimatter.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Crimson Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

A harmonic generation device converts the output of the freighter engines to A T L A S frequencies, radiating a painfully crimson trail.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Hadal Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

Organically altering the hue of freighter exhaust, this engine modification utilises the bioluminescence of abyssal sea creatures to generate its striking turquoise colouration.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Golden Freighter Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier.

The extreme heat of the freighter's engines excites this filter of sodium salts, tinting the exhaust with a vivid golden hue.

Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

Technologies.Name: Teleport Chamber
Technologies.Subtitle: Long-Distance Matter Transfer Device
Technologies.Description:
Vital integrated freighter equipment. This personal teleport device allows the user to move quickly between their freighter, planetary bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network. User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Technologies.Name: Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes)
Technologies.Subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
Technologies.Description:
A small barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

Technologies.Name: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
Technologies.Subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
Technologies.Description:
A large barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

Technologies.Name: Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes)
Technologies.Subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
Technologies.Description:
A huge barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

Technologies.Name: Explosive Drones
Technologies.Subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This pack of autonomous explosives have been programmed to launch from the fleet and pilot themselves directly towards hostile vessels. Extremely dangerous.

Technologies.Name: Holographic Analyser
Technologies.Subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful analytic computer overclocks the existing fleet systems, allowing for faster-than-light calculations. Heat is a problem, and the chips do not last long.

Technologies.Name: Mineral Compressor
Technologies.Subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

The mineral compressor allows fleet mining crews to liquidise the substances they extract, for both faster processing and easier transportation.

Technologies.Name: Fuel Oxidiser
Technologies.Subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful fuel upgrade overloads frigate engines, allowing for faster-than-usual travel.

Technologies.Name: Mind Control Device
Technologies.Subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

The mind control device plugs into the ship's trading and communications systems, allowing the Fleet Commander to gain the upper hand in any negotiation.

Technologies.Name: Salvaged Frigate Module
Technologies.Subtitle: Capital Ship Wiring Platform
Technologies.Description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from freighter crashsites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Useless in its current form, a Research Station aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.

Technologies.Name: Carbon Crystal
Technologies.Subtitle: Concentrated Carbon Deposit
Technologies.Description:
Hyper-compressed carbon, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component.

Synthesised from Condensed Carbon.

Technologies.Name: Amplified Warp Shielding
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Red Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Chromatic Warp Shielding
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Green Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Temporal Warp Computer
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Blue Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix,  preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Resonance Matrix
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Purple Systems
Technologies.Description:
Sideloads a resonant memory packet into your warp computer,  allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding purple stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Warp Core Resonator
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
Technologies.Description:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.

Quantum resonation improves the robustness of the drive during FTL travel, granting the ability to leap to stars previously out of reach.

Technologies.Name: Plasmatic Warp Injector
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
Technologies.Description:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.

Hyperdrive benefits from advanced fusion that brings starship to higher warp speed and intensity. User's craft will become able to leap deeper into space, and into more distant planetary systems.

Technologies.Name: Reality De-Threader
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
Technologies.Description:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.

Uncapped, yet stabilised, fusion systems are threaded into user's hyperdrive. Allows starship to jump ever longer distances in deep space.

Technologies.Name: Freighter Hyperdrive
Technologies.Subtitle: Lightspeed Warp Drive
Technologies.Description: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

Technologies.Name: Atmospheric Control Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter Life Support Module
Technologies.Description:
A critical freighter subsystem, vital for maintaining a habitable and safe environment for all on-board organic lifeforms.

Capable of generated a limited breathable atmosphere even when damaged or unpowered, but only for a short period of time.

Technologies.Name: Singularity Engine
Technologies.Subtitle: Wormhole Propulsion Drive
Technologies.Description:
An unstable and highly-experimental piece of freighter hyperdrive technology. This extreme gravity device generates a wormhole deep within the freighter's reactor core, inverting the entire vessel and transporting it across the universe.

Speak to the freighter's commander to engage the drive. Warning: destination is not controllable.

Technologies.Name: Interstellar Scanner
Technologies.Subtitle: Long Range Sensor Technology
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the freighter's galactic-scale sensors.

This device allows the user to access detailed economic and conflict data for a system, even without having previously visited.

Technologies.Name: Matter Beam
Technologies.Subtitle: Freighter-Mounted Teleportation Device
Technologies.Description:
A device that modulates standard freighter communication signals to enable the interplanetary transport of matter as well as data.

Freighters fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's Exosuit over a long distance.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur Geobay
Technologies.Subtitle: Heavy Loader Storage Bay
Technologies.Description:
A secure parking, summoning and customisation facility for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.

The Minotaur Geobay can be constructed anywhere on a planet's surface.

Deploy the Minotaur from the Quick Menu. With the aid of an Orbital Exocraft Materialiser mounted inside a freighter, the Minotaur can be instantly deployed to any location within the same system as the mothership.

Technologies.Name: Deep-space Lure
Technologies.Subtitle: Anomaly Attraction Device
Technologies.Description:
A single-use device for locating a deep-space Gaseous Sentience. The lure generates an electromagnetic field of an intriguing nature to these highly advanced lifeforms.

Select the Lure and use Generate Field (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

Technologies.Name: Gravitino Coil
Technologies.Subtitle: Industrial Waste Manipulation Device
Technologies.Description:
This remarkable technology transforms the Multi-Tool into a powerful kinetic manipulator, capable of attracting and repelling industrial waste via a localised magnetic field.

Access the Gravitino Coil by pressing CYCLEWEAPON, and attract industrial waste with ALTATTACK. Magnetised objects can be launched from the Coil with ATTACK, or gently released with ALTATTACK.

Technologies.Name: Gravitino Host
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
A strange, potentially parasitic plant that yields an occasional harvest of the highly tradable commodity, Gravitino Balls.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 2 hours

Technologies.Name: Plasma Launcher
Technologies.Subtitle: Explosive Grenades
Technologies.Description:
High-impact projectile weapon. Launched plasma shells bounce off surfaces until their internal timer triggers a large explosion.
 
Charged with Unstable Plasma. Careless use can result in damage to user.
 
Press ALTATTACK to activate.

Technologies.Name: Unstable Plasma
Technologies.Subtitle: Plasma Launcher Recharge
Technologies.Description:
Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the Plasma Launcher.
 
Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.

Technologies.Name: Personal Forcefield
Technologies.Subtitle: Defensive Shield Technology
Technologies.Description:
On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to overload the Multi-Tool, distorting the electromagnetic field around the user and creating a powerful personal shield.

While this field offers substantial protection against incoming laser fire, the user is advised that the Multi-Tool cannot be used for other functions while powering the shield.

Technologies.Name: Cadmium Drive
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Red Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Emeril Drive
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Green Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Indium Drive
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Blue Systems
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix,  preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Atlantid Drive
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Purple Systems
Technologies.Description:
Sideloads a resonant memory packet into your warp computer,  allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding purple stellar bodies.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Health Station
Technologies.Subtitle: Health recharge module
Technologies.Description: A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge health.

Technologies.Name: Wonder Projector
Technologies.Subtitle: Discovery Display Hologram
Technologies.Description:
A buildable holographic display, designed to visualise any discovery currently listed in your Personal Records.

Use the projector to manage these records directly, or view them from the Wonders section of the Catalogue.

Technologies.Name: Spawning Cowl
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Hood
Technologies.Description:
This grand hood is worn by the upper ranks of Gek at events and conventions, distinguishing the esteemed Trade Lord from the lowly Hireling.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit with this exclusive Appearance Override at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Auxiliary Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Rare Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Full of heavy metals and precious synthetics, this is a valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Data Packet
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Still sealed, this is an extremely valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Compressed Plasma
Technologies.Subtitle: Rare Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Full of heavy metals and precious synthetics, this is a valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Industrial Salvage
Technologies.Subtitle: Common Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
A tainted metallic shell. Though damaged, its core components can be recycled into valuable materials.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Reactor Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Rare Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Full of heavy metals and precious synthetics, this is a valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Cpu Harness
Technologies.Subtitle: Rare Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Still sealed, this is an extremely valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist Salvage Material
Technologies.Description:
Still sealed, this is an extremely valuable piece of industrial salvage.

Harvested from the decaying remains of a collapsing space hulk. This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Hydraulic Wiring
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Hyperdrive
Technologies.Subtitle: Lightspeed Warp Drive
Technologies.Description:
FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Crimson Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Interstellar Atlas Propulsion
Technologies.Description:
A raw optic organ, red and unblinking. Suspended above the ship's engines, it gazes down tunnels in spacetime, allowing FTL travel between star systems.

Direct the core's attention to remote destinations via the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Frameshift Catapult
Technologies.Subtitle: Illegally Modified Warp Drive
Technologies.Description:
This experimental drive augments conventional hyperdrive technology by distorting local geometry at the point of warp initialisation, boosting range and efficiency far beyond standard drives.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through the Galactic Map.

Technologies.Name: Warp Cell
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit
Technologies.Description:
This antimatter-based fuel is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a starship hyperdrive.

Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.

Technologies.Name: Warp Hypercore
Technologies.Subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit
Technologies.Description:
A high-capacity antimatter-based fuel, this cell harnesses an internal black hole generator to power starship hyperdrives across multiple warp jumps.

Cell walls are specially designed to reflect any reality paradoxes back towards the heart of the unit, where they generate additional power.

Technologies.Name: Memory Fragment (inventory)
Technologies.Subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo
Technologies.Description:
The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.

The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

Technologies.Name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
Technologies.Description:
A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs.

Synthesised from Di-hydrogen.

Technologies.Name: Jetpack
Technologies.Subtitle: Aerial Propulsion Booster
Technologies.Description:
Provides the Exosuit with advanced movement capabilities, including temporary flight.

Control thrust with JUMP. The flightpack uses energy from the Exosuit Life Support system to pressurise and vent bursts of gas, propelling the user into the air.

Jetpack can be temporarily overloaded by gathering Deuterium-rich plants, causing a dramatic increase in available thrust.

Technologies.Name: Blue Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Indium injection nozzles add a dazzling blue flair to the Jetpack's output.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Jetpack Bubble Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Specially conditioned oil is added to the jetpack's exhaust jets, creating a stream of pearlescent bubbles as it operates.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Festive Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A multi-coloured scattering of bio-plastic flakes adds a celebratory flair to the Jetpack's output. Expelled material is fully compostable.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Discordant Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

The jetpack exhaust is augmented with an atlantideum filter. When activated, its discordant effect is spilled across the landscape, a trail of dissonant reverberations that echo on an unknowable frequency.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Antimatter Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Baryon suppressors alter the Jetpack's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Electric Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Humidifiers discharge a highly salinated mist from the rocket nozzles, conducting a dramatic streak of electricity during Jetpack operation.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Scorching Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Pressurised jets breathe additional oxygen into the Jetpack flames, brightening and lengthening the exhaust trail.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Pyrotechnic Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Pellets of chromatic metal ignite during flight, splitting into glittering stars of RGB.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Fusion Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Harnesses natural stellar processes to make the Jetpack output blaze. A light-diffusing compound protects the user and onlookers from retinal damage.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Green Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Emeril injection nozzles add a rich green flair to the Jetpack's output.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Plasma Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Replaces the standard Jetpack combustion chamber with a plasma engine. During flight, the exhaust nozzles release dazzling clouds of ionised matter.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Rainbow Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Jetpack's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Red Jetpack Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Cadmium injection nozzles add a bold red flair to the Jetpack's output.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Vigilant Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A Jetpack trail emitting the light of living stone; plucked from a slumbering guardian; focused and consolidated through a series of lenses.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Reality Glitch Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

The jetpack exhaust is fitted with a high-concentrate pugneum dispenser. When the jets are activated, the resulting reaction carves miniature distortions in reality, and creates an interesting visual effect.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Ink-stained Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A localised anomaly within the jetpack's core allows the spectral afterglow of the boundary horrors to leak across into this reality.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Ghastly Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Attaches an active bio-chamber to the Jetpack's exhaust nozzles. During flight, the thrusters warm and expel the slimy juice contained within.
Note: Contains living worms. Ejected worms may infest local ecosystems.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Rare Metal Element
Technologies.Subtitle: Concentrated Metal Deposit
Technologies.Description:
A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies.

Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution.

Synthesised from Magnetised Ferrite.

Technologies.Name: Mining Beam
Technologies.Subtitle: Mineral Extraction Laser
Technologies.Description:
Multi-Tool Mining Beam powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.

Installs focusing optics within the Multi-Tool, allowing it to emit a high-energy beam. The beam is calibrated to excite molecules within common organic or geological objects, allowing it to operate as a highly effective mining device.

WARNING: Destruction of flora, fauna or minerals may attract Sentinel attention.

Technologies.Name: Plasma Resonator
Technologies.Subtitle: Mining Beam Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
A significant upgrade for the Mining Beam.

Upgrades the Mining Laser's primary crystal chamber, boosting core beam energy while decreasing unwanted heat spill.

Technologies.Name: Launch Thruster
Technologies.Subtitle: Vertical Take-off System
Technologies.Description:
Vital launch and landing gear system.
 
User is advised that specialised, Deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
 
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Neural Assembly
Technologies.Subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
Technologies.Description:
An array of distributed neurons, fused to a board of metallic strands. Complex patterns of electrical impulses weave their way across the surface, knotting each ship system together.
 
Hold THRUST to inquire if the ship would like to take off.

Technologies.Name: Anti-Gravity Well
Technologies.Subtitle: Aeron Sub-Orbital Engine
Technologies.Description:
Gently detaches the starship from gravitational fields, lifting it toward the stars.
 
The well hungers for pugneum or radiant shards, and must be sufficiently fueled before launch.
 
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Advanced Launch System
Technologies.Subtitle: Bespoke Landing Gear
Technologies.Description:
A custom-made launch control system for high-performance starships. Sensitive gyroscopes and specialised control circuits plot custom take-off routines for increased launch speed and efficiency.
 
Specialised, deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
 
Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Starship Launch Fuel
Technologies.Subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
Technologies.Description:
Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel Starship Launch Thrusters.

Created from crystallised Di-hydrogen, found in blue deposits on all worlds.

Technologies.Name: Pilot Interface
Technologies.Subtitle: Glass / Boundary Terminal
Technologies.Description:
This device allows a pilot's brain to interface with the mind of the Sentinel Interceptor, granting the pilot access to ship control systems and external sensors.

The enmeshing of the pilot's mind with that of the vessel is necessary to prevent rejection/consumption of the pilot by the ship's vestigial cockpit.

Technologies.Name: Log Encryption Key
Technologies.Subtitle: Incomplete Data Sequence
Technologies.Description:
A fragment of the encryption override sequence for a freighter's emergency log.

Several parts of the sequence may be required to gain full access to recorded data.

Technologies.Name: Star Bramble
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
A medium-sized, farmable plant that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Star Bulbs.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Lush climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

Technologies.Name: Magnetic Resonator
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
An electromagnetic frequency oscillator, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Ancient Lock
Technologies.Subtitle: Heavy Locking Mechanism
Technologies.Description: A mysterious lock with several keyholes, this relic protects what must surely be a valuable treasure.

Technologies.Name: Bait Box
Technologies.Subtitle: Automatic Bait Dispenser
Technologies.Description:
Insert bait or lures to attract specific fish, or to improve catch chances. Note: any foodstuff may be used as bait.

Current Bait: %BAIT%
Catch Rarity Improvement: %RARE_BOOST%%
Catch Size Improvement %SIZE_BOOST%%
Other notes: %NOTES%

Technologies.Name: Furnace Tank
Technologies.Subtitle: Fuel Incineration Device
Technologies.Description:
High-temperature burn unit, designed to consume a wide range of biological material. Insert materials to initiate burn.

When active, drives an internal turbine to generate power.

Technologies.Name: Finished Dish
Technologies.Subtitle: Storage Hopper
Technologies.Description: A hopper for storing the materials generated by the refinery

Technologies.Name: Auto-Trap
Technologies.Subtitle: Self-Sustaining Auto Creel
Technologies.Description:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions. Return later to collect trapped fish.

Trap cycle: IN PROGRESS

Technologies.Name: Ingestor Empty
Technologies.Subtitle: Automatic Feeding Unit
Technologies.Description:
The nutrient ingestor improves exosuit performance via the automatic portioning and processing of various cooked items.

Current Nutrition Source: %NAME%
Duration: %TIME%
Effect: %EFFECT%

Technologies.Name: Tiny motor
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

Technologies.Name: Transmission Box
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.

Technologies.Name: Cooling system
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

Technologies.Name: Thermoregulator
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

Technologies.Name: Servo Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

Technologies.Name: Solenoid
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

Technologies.Name: Pressure Chamber
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

Technologies.Name: Master Circuit
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

Technologies.Name: Power Distributor
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

Technologies.Name: Photovoltaic Panel
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

Technologies.Name: Fuel Inverter
Technologies.Subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
Technologies.Description: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The fuel inverter ensures an even flow of power to autonomous machines.

Technologies.Name: Membrane Battery
Technologies.Subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
Technologies.Description: The membrane battery is an almost maintenance-free piece of rechargeable power technology. Nestled among in the machine's circuits, it supplies power safely and directly.

Technologies.Name: Power Condenser
Technologies.Subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
Technologies.Description: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The power condenser harvests any heat energy wasted during the machine's operation, and uses it to generate extra power.

Technologies.Name: Generator Coupling
Technologies.Subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
Technologies.Description: The generator coupling is an important piece of the machine's rechargeable power systems. Without it, the generator would fruitlessly spin, pumping power out into the void.

Technologies.Name: Kinetic Dynamo
Technologies.Subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
Technologies.Description: The kinetic dynamo takes a small initial charge and uses it to run power-harvesting systems that tap into the orbit of the planet. This frees autonomous machinery from frequent fuel inspections, allowing them to endure extremely long maintenance cycles.

Technologies.Name: Extractor Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Stellar Extractor Core
Technologies.Description:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.

Powered directly from the freighter's main electrical loop. Functionality is entirely autonomous.

Technologies.Name: Glyph One
Technologies.Subtitle: Ancient Technology
Technologies.Description:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.

The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum
