Technologies.Name: Portal Repository
Technologies.Subtitle: Mind Ark Notch
Technologies.Description:
A groove cut into the smooth grey stone of the Portal.

A light within pulses gently, expectant.

Technologies.Name: Frayed Synaptic Fibre
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Neural Component
Technologies.Description: A critically damaged component housed within what appears to be the processing centre of a fallen swarmer. Partial functionality could be restored by repairing the component.

Technologies.Name: Shattered Cortex
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Neural Component
Technologies.Description: A critically damaged component housed within what appears to be the processing centre of a fallen swarmer. Partial functionality could be restored by repairing the component.

Technologies.Name: Flickering Holo-Bank
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Neural Component
Technologies.Description: A critically damaged component housed within what appears to be the processing centre of a fallen swarmer. Partial functionality could be restored by repairing the component.

Technologies.Name: Pearl Offering
Technologies.Subtitle: Offering to the Sea
Technologies.Description: The chest requires a Living Pearl, harvested from the giant mother-molluscs that grow on the ocean floor.

Technologies.Name: Trident Key
Technologies.Subtitle: Offering to the Sea
Technologies.Description: The chest requires a Trident Key, given to those who study the mysterious sites in the deep ocean.

Technologies.Name: Locking mechanism
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A simple locking device, designed to keep out unauthorised pilferers. Damage has locked it permanently.

Technologies.Name: Tamper Prevention Device
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A unit designed to destroy vital systems in the event that the device is tampered with by an unauthorised party. Unfortunately, it has itself malfunctioned and will continue to damage other systems until repaired.

Technologies.Name: Security Alarm
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small light/klaxon hybrid, designed to warn of unauthorised access to the device. Damage to the alarm has caused it to overload and short other nearby circuits.

Technologies.Name: Spring Casing
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The casing for a high-compression spring. The casing has ruptured, causing the spring to shoot out and damage the rest of the device.

Technologies.Name: Thermoregulator
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

Technologies.Name: Fuel Pump
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A high-capacity pump, ensuring that fuel reaches every part of the device in all gravitational conditions. The filter is clogged with a strange substance, causing it to lose power.

Technologies.Name: Servo Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

Technologies.Name: Solenoid
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

Technologies.Name: Pressure Chamber
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

Technologies.Name: Master Circuit
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

Technologies.Name: Power Distributor
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

Technologies.Name: Magnetic Lock
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: An advanced locking device. A polarity incident has caused it to seal shut permanently.

Technologies.Name: Load Balancer
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small unit designed to regulate the flow of power across the device. A malfunction is causing it to short, damaging other components.

Technologies.Name: Network Interface
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A universal network interface, allowing the device to connect to a remote control centre. Damage to this interface is causing it to interpret background radiation as network signals, corrupting data in other circuits.

Technologies.Name: Safety Panel
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The safety panel seals off potentially dangerous components in the event of a malfunction. An over sensitive trigger has caused it to activate, preventing the device from operating.

Technologies.Name: Alternator
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The alternator generates and regulates power for the device. A strange corrosion seeps through it, preventing it from working.

Technologies.Name: Photovoltaic Panel
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

Technologies.Name: Transmission Box
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.

Technologies.Name: Superconductive Lock
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A highly advanced locking device. Damage to the circuits supplying the magnet has caused it to lock permanently.

Technologies.Name: Input terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A terminal designed to allow manual control of the device. Damage prevents it actually receiving any input.

Technologies.Name: Bio-input sensor
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: An advanced control unit, designed to allow device/flesh interaction. Damage prevents it functioning correctly. Interfacing while it is in this state is not advised.

Technologies.Name: Boiler Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A small boiler, generating heat to allow the device to function in difficult climates. A malfunction has resulted in a damaging boiler overflow.

Technologies.Name: Tiny motor
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

Technologies.Name: Cooling system
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

Technologies.Name: Output screen
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Component
Technologies.Description: A display terminal designed to communicate the device's status to the user. As the terminal is broken, the user cannot be made aware that the terminal is broken.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Body
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Legs
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Left Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles, perfect for keeping hostiles in place while advancing to close range.

Technologies.Name: Liquidator Right Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system - a flamethrower for extreme damage at close range.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

Technologies.Name: Ariadne's Flame
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Thruster System
Technologies.Description:
A series of agile, high-powered jet thrusters mounted to the rear of the rear of the Minotaur. Precise use allows the Minotaur to quickly and powerfully traverse all manner of terrain.

Press and hold JUMP to activate. Limited in-flight control is possible.

Technologies.Name: Daedalus Engine
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Power Unit
Technologies.Description:
A compact reactor unit, this engine is the heart of the Minotaur. It is mounted on a gyroscope to prevent fuel incidents during rapid movement.

Powered by conventional carbon-base fuels.

Technologies.Name: Self-Greasing Servos
Technologies.Subtitle: Motor Efficiency Upgrade
Technologies.Description:
An automatically-regulated lubricant dispenser fitted to the leg joints of the Minotaur reduce friction and encourage fuel-efficient motion.

Significantly reduces fuel burn in the Minotaur's Daedalus Engine.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur Cannon
Technologies.Subtitle: Heavy Mounted Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.

Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur Laser
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Mining Utility
Technologies.Description:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.

Enables conventional mining operations. Ineffective in combat scenarios.

Technologies.Name: Precision Minotaur Laser
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Minotaur Mining Laser
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid's laser array system.

Amplifies the power deployed by the mining beam, increasing mining speed and enabling the processing of difficult to mine raw materials.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur Bore
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Digging Laser
Technologies.Description:
Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser array of the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.

A special mount allows the rapid deployment of a high-energy terrain excavator, without risking clogging the Minotaur's delicate joints and servos with dirt.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur AI Pilot
Technologies.Subtitle: Autonomous Control Unit
Technologies.Description:
A semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin for the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

Piloting routines are highly localised. It is incapable of developing emotional bonds nor exercising independent control of the Minotaur.

Technologies.Name: Minotaur Radar Array
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Scan Attachment
Technologies.Description:
A high-detail radar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard the Minotaur to Analysis Visor levels.

Press SCAN to activate a radar sweep, revealing additional points of interest that cannot be located via a Multi-Tool scanner.

Use the Quick Menu to tune the radar to specific buildings.

Technologies.Name: Hardframe Body
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Core Replacement
Technologies.Description:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

Technologies.Name: Hardframe Legs
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

Technologies.Name: Hardframe Left Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

When installed alongside a Minotaur Laser, it transforms the mining laser into a powerful combat upgrade with the ability to deal heavy damaged to stunned entities.

Technologies.Name: Hardframe Right Arm
Technologies.Subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
Technologies.Description:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles and serves as an excellent support weapon to the Minotaur's primary cannon.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

Technologies.Name: Communications Station
Technologies.Subtitle: Communications terminal
Technologies.Description: A terminal for the composition and transmission of messages to other travellers.

Technologies.Name: Message Module
Technologies.Subtitle: Communications terminal
Technologies.Description: A small and accessible information container for leaving messages or viewing left messages and short strings of information.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Bloodpr_10
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_10.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Bloodpr_4
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_4.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Bloodpr_9
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_9.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Bloodpr_11
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_11.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Bloodpr_0
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_0.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

Technologies.Name: Microprocessor
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A compact, low-heat microchip. Assembled from processed Chromatic Metal, created from one of several specialised terrain metals.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Solar Mirror
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Carbon Nanotubes
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
Metres and metres of high capacity carbon nanotubes.

Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many advanced technologies.

Technologies.Name: Navigation Data
Technologies.Subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data
Technologies.Description:
Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region.

May be traded with a Cartographer aboard a Space Station in exchange for usable star charts.

Technologies.Name: Exosuit Upgrade Chart
Technologies.Subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data
Technologies.Description:
Encoded navigation data which, when properly decrypted, will reveal the location of a Drop Pod containing an Exosuit Inventory Upgrade.

Select the coordinates in the inventory and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

Technologies.Name: Exosuit Backpack
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A tough, modular backpack unit. Its styling calls to mind a previous era of exploration.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Feature
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Nipnip
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
This medicinal herb is known for its pungent buds, which are harvested to produce Gek Nip. NipNip thrives in dank environments, and often grows as a weed.

Suitable for hydroponic planting indoors. Needs a tropical or humid climate before planting outdoors.

Technologies.Name: Noise Box
Technologies.Subtitle: Audio Device
Technologies.Description:
A special construction module designed to emit a high-frequency noise. Pitch may be adjusted to the user's requirements.

Requires power to operate.

Technologies.Name: Construction Terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist terminal
Technologies.Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Construction Overseers, and equipped with architectural and engineering design software.

Technologies.Name: Agricultural Terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist terminal
Technologies.Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Farmers, and equipped for the analysis and cultivation of farmable crops.

Technologies.Name: Science Terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist terminal
Technologies.Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Scientists, and equipped for research and development of scientific blueprints.

Technologies.Name: Weapons Terminal
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist terminal
Technologies.Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Armourers, and equipped for the development of munitions and explosives as well as selected civilian tech.

Technologies.Name: Oxygen Harvester
Technologies.Subtitle: Atmosphere Processing Device
Technologies.Description:
An autonomous atmosphere extractor, this device can be left to collect and purify oxygen from the air. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.

The resulting gas is compressed and processed, ready for use in all standard life support systems.

Technologies.Name: Obsolete Technology
Technologies.Subtitle: Old, unusable technology
Technologies.Description:
A piece of technology, corrupted by interference from the Atlas.

Can be recycled for usable components.

Technologies.Name: Void Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Curiosity
Technologies.Description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

Technologies.Name: Superoxide Crystal
Technologies.Subtitle: Concentrated Oxygen Deposit
Technologies.Description:
A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of advanced technologies. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended.

Synthesised from Oxygen.

Technologies.Name: Oxygen Filter
Technologies.Subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
Technologies.Description:
A specialist technology component.

This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.

Technologies.Name: Albumen Pearl Orb
Technologies.Subtitle: Orb Plant
Technologies.Description:
A medium-sized, farmable Crystal Orb that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Albumen Pearls.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 80 mins

Technologies.Name: Gene Edit
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Gene Edit

Technologies.Name: Mutated!
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Mutated!

Technologies.Name: Photonix Core
Technologies.Subtitle: Pulse Engine Companion Unit
Technologies.Description: Provides increased manoeuvrability and longer boosts during spaceflight.

Technologies.Name: Rendezvous Beacon
Technologies.Subtitle: Navigational Data Recorder
Technologies.Description:
An unmarked navigation beacon, acquired from the wreck of a downed starship.

Use Activate Beacon (FE_ALT1) to deploy the beacon and retrace the final steps of the crashed ship.

Technologies.Name: Ticket to Freedom
Technologies.Subtitle: Secure System Pass
Technologies.Description:
"Glorious survivor! The promised star will be yours!"

A Secure system pass bearing the mark of the 'Voice of Freedom'. 
Select the pass and use Accept Invitation (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

Technologies.Name: Pirate Map Fragment 1 of 3
Technologies.Subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
Technologies.Description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a troubled freighter captain. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"We Blight this new galaxy, as we did the last, as we will the next!"

The data is of value to pirate faction The Blight, who attempted to retrieve it by violent means.

Technologies.Name: Pirate Map Fragment 2 of 3
Technologies.Subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
Technologies.Description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a freighter shot down by pirate faction The Blight. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"The galactic tunnels belong to the Blight!"

The navigational information is corrupted, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the freighter captain.

Technologies.Name: Pirate Map Fragment 3 of 3
Technologies.Subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
Technologies.Description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a starship crashed on an ocean bed. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"Annihilate every Traveller! All galaxies will fall to Blight!"

The navigational information is unreadable in its current state, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the freighter captain.

Technologies.Name: Outlaws
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Outlaws
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Defence Chit
Technologies.Subtitle: System Authority Payment Substitute
Technologies.Description: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.

Technologies.Name: Gutrot Flower
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
A foul-smelling, farmable flower that replicates the chemical structure of faecal matter. When planted inside, yields a harvest of Faecium.

A good alternative to collecting Faecium by hand, which requires feeding creatures and then harvesting their droppings. Gutrot Flowers must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Quicksilver
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
The liquid's silvered surface forms a perfect mirror, your own face reflected back as you examine it. But the more you stare, the less perfect the mirror becomes. The face in the image moves. It blinks. It -

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 to reveal the location of nearby portals.

Technologies.Name: Ion Battery
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
Technologies.Description:
Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.
 
Constructed by fusing Ferrite Dust with underground Cobalt. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.

Technologies.Name: Advanced Ion Battery
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
Technologies.Description:
Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.

Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.

Technologies.Name: Haz-Mat Gauntlet
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Augmentation
Technologies.Description:
Upgrades the metallic shielding of the Exosuit's gloves.

An advanced blend of reinforced metal and catalytic shielding allows the user to safely handle hazardous substances, as well as perform the necessary feats of strength required to harvest certain farmable flora.

Technologies.Name: Electrical Cloaking Unit
Technologies.Subtitle: Power Distribution Module
Technologies.Description:
Device to enable a wireless aesthetic in habitable bases.

Constructing the Electrical Cloaking Unit within a powered base will reduce the visual prominence of all local Electrical Wiring. Hidden wires will continue to supply electricity, provided they are sufficiently powered.

Technologies.Name: Pressure Membrane
Technologies.Subtitle: Reinforced Barometric Stabiliser
Technologies.Description:
Extreme pressure environments - such as deep water - cause elevated stress on the Exosuit's oxygen circulation and general life support systems.

Installation of this reinforced pressurisation shell increases efficiency and protection while operating in high-pressure environments.

Technologies.Name: Oxygen Capsule
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
Technologies.Description:
Stablised and secure life support filtration gas.

Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.

Technologies.Name: Life Support Gel
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
Technologies.Description:
Emergency life support fuel.

Synthesised from rocket fuel crystals and carbon, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.

Technologies.Name: Hazard Protection
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Environmental Shielding
Technologies.Description:
The Exosuit's Hazard Protection system continually monitors and stabilises the user's environment. 

General reactive protection may be augmented with Environmental Shields, offering increased protection against specific conditions.

The device is charged with sodium-based substances. User is advised that a failure to charge the Hazard Protection system may allow their environment to become incompatible with life.

Technologies.Name: Reality Anchor
Technologies.Subtitle: Spacetime Tether
Technologies.Description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper anchor is required...

Technologies.Name: Reality Anchor
Technologies.Subtitle: Spacetime Tether
Technologies.Description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper anchor is required...

Technologies.Name: Anomalous Scaffold
Technologies.Subtitle: Crystalline Breach
Technologies.Description:
To bridge between realities requires a scaffold and a seed.

This crystalline propagation matrix will allow the breach to become the bridge, the seed by which a new reality can bloom.

Technologies.Name: Memories of Atlantid
Technologies.Subtitle: Forgotten Void Data
Technologies.Description:
The howling of an advanced intelligence banished to oblivion, a reverberation in sentience and crystal. 

Each memory in this data packet is an entire reality in itself, bearing the fingerprint of countless lives. The Atlas will recognise this seed.

Technologies.Name: Reality Anchor
Technologies.Subtitle: Spacetime Tether
Technologies.Description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper anchor is required...

Technologies.Name: Quicksilver
Technologies.Subtitle: Reward Item
Technologies.Description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.

Technologies.Name: Race Force Amplifier
Technologies.Subtitle: Race Part
Technologies.Description: Provides a boost to your Exocraft during races.

Technologies.Name: Race Obstacle
Technologies.Subtitle: Race Part
Technologies.Description: Provides extra challenge for Exocraft races.

Technologies.Name: Race Initiator
Technologies.Subtitle: Race Part
Technologies.Description: This platform acts as the start and finish line for Exocraft field tests, allowing Travellers to practice manoeuvring and speed.

Technologies.Name: Starship Race Initiator
Technologies.Subtitle: Race Part
Technologies.Description: This platform acts as the start and finish line for Starship field tests, allowing Travellers to practice manoeuvring and speed.

Technologies.Name: Gamma Weed
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
A luminous, leafy flowering plant that thrives in radioactive biomes and can be cultivated to yield a bountiful harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Radioactive climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

Technologies.Name: Blaze Javelin
Technologies.Subtitle: Energy Beam Weapon
Technologies.Description:
Aggressive weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.

The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets.

Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.

Technologies.Name: Thermic Condensate
Technologies.Subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.

Crafted from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon.

Technologies.Name: Enriched Carbon
Technologies.Subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.

Crafted from Radon and Condensed Carbon.

Technologies.Name: Nitrogen Salt
Technologies.Subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
Technologies.Description:
A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.

Crafted from Nitrogen and Condensed Carbon.

Technologies.Name: Repair Kit
Technologies.Subtitle: Automatic Patching Unit
Technologies.Description:
A highly useful piece of survival technology, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order.

While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.

Technologies.Name: Whalesong Flute
Technologies.Subtitle: Cosmic Melody Instrument
Technologies.Description:
A powerful but mellow musical instrument, capable of relaying song through space via gently undulating electromagnetic waves.

Use Relay Song (FE_ALT1) while in deep space to broadcast the flute's melody...

Technologies.Name: Memory Fragment (class)
Technologies.Subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo
Technologies.Description:
The shattered remnants of a previous existence. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.

The memory will manifest as a ship or Multi-Tool class upgrade to aid you in this iteration. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

DEATH IS NOT THE END SLASH THE LOOP CONTINUES

Technologies.Name: Memory Fragment
Technologies.Subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo
Technologies.Description:
The shattered remnants of a previous existence. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.

The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade to aid you in this iteration. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

DEATH IS NOT THE END SLASH THE LOOP CONTINUES

Technologies.Name: Memory Resonator
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Manifestation Technology
Technologies.Description:
A highly familar, entirely novel, piece of technology, designed by Specialist Polo as part of their loop research efforts. It synchronises its vibrations with the underlying song of the universe, allowing it to reveal memory hotspots within the loop.

Begin the resonance alignment process with FE_ALT1.

Technologies.Name: Memory Fragment (personal Weapon)
Technologies.Subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo
Technologies.Description:
The shattered remnants of a previous existence. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.

The memory will manifest as a Multi-Tool weapon to aid you in this iteration. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

DEATH IS NOT THE END SLASH THE LOOP CONTINUES

Technologies.Name: MEMORY IMPRINT I
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Artifact
Technologies.Description:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The leviathan was like nothing I've ever seen.
So vast as to blot out the sun.
I wanted it. I deserve to have it! It will be mine.
But it resisted, would not come quietly.
It wailed and it wailed as the infra-knife carved into its meat.
It almost took me down with it. Perhaps it has. Perhaps..."

Technologies.Name: MEMORY IMPRINT II
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Artifact
Technologies.Description:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The same nightmare chases me: a wail fills my cockpit, the dashboard controls gummed with blood.
I have given up sleep. I pulse past blurred stars.
And then there it was: majestic, drifting in the ocean of space.
Something inside me burns for it. I must have it.
Its great fin flexed toward my ship, and my hull was gone..."

Technologies.Name: MEMORY IMPRINT III
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Artifact
Technologies.Description:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"Today should have been the day. Their hour was at hand.
It must be mine. They are like nothing I've ever seen.
Everything was prepared. But it moved faster than I thought possible. As though it knew where I would fly, before I knew it myself.
A great tentacle hugged my ship, my cockpit - pressing my suit down to the bone. This suit will be my grave."

Technologies.Name: MEMORY IMPRINT IV
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Artifact
Technologies.Description:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The chase is over, and I have lost.
The giants will endure, and I will end.
As I plummeted from the sky, I saw another ship falling alongside mine. Then another, and another.
I may have imagined it. The misfiring of a dying mind...
Those creatures were so beautiful. But it is all ended now.
They will haunt my thoughts no longer."

Technologies.Name: MEMORY IMPRINT V
Technologies.Subtitle: Loop Artifact
Technologies.Description:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"I came face-to-face with a creature more beautiful and bizarre than anything I have ever seen.
Despite no discernible eyes, I do not believe it is blind.
It was huge, glorious, serene. But then - with a flick of its tentacles, it was gone.
I have thought of nothing else since. I can only think of the whale. whale. whale. wail."

The memory will manifest as an Exosuit technology upgrade to aid you in this iteration. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

Technologies.Name: Seed of Dreams
Technologies.Subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
Technologies.Description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. This mere atom contains boundless noise, each tiny vibration the hopes and dreams of entire lifetimes.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

Technologies.Name: Seed of Power
Technologies.Subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
Technologies.Description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A particle of indescribable energy, it is unclear how to continues to exist within this reality.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

Technologies.Name: Seed of Will
Technologies.Subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
Technologies.Description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A flash of pure light and fury, this seed contains the unsuppressable need to exist.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

Technologies.Name: Seed of Life
Technologies.Subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
Technologies.Description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. Though a mere speck, this seed contains the potential for an entire universe; a boundless, glorious expansion.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

Technologies.Name: Seed of Hope
Technologies.Subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
Technologies.Description:
A seed of creation, a perfect droplet of infinity. A gift from the Atlas, this is a tiny fragment of all the universe's dreams, will, power and life; a fragment of the Travellers; a fragment of myself.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

Technologies.Name: Echo Collective
Technologies.Subtitle: Consciousness Housing
Technologies.Description:
A shifting vortex of atlantideum, attuned to the growing collective will housed inside Nada's Prime Terminal. Current sentience threshold: ??%.

The grains oscillate in a pattern, but the message is unintelligible.

Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Head
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp, before being infused with Atlantideum.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

This sentience was fused with a lattice of Atlantideum, as though it had germinated together with the crystal.

Technologies.Subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas
Technologies.Description:
This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures.

Technologies.Name: Lost Angler's Rig
Technologies.Subtitle: Unique Angling Device
Technologies.Description:
A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary Lost Angler.

Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

Technologies.Name: The Angler's Diary
Technologies.Subtitle: Collected Flotsam
Technologies.Description:
A message recovered from a bottle stowed beneath the seat of the starship. It reads:

"I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price.
And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the Celeste, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..."
%PARTY_1%

Technologies.Name: The Angler's Diary
Technologies.Subtitle: Collected Flotsam
Technologies.Description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"The rumours were true. It's out there, I can feel it. Not here, but somewhere. The water calls to me, I just need to follow its voice..."
%PARTY_3%

Technologies.Name: The Angler's Diary
Technologies.Subtitle: Collected Flotsam
Technologies.Description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"I saw it in my dreams last night. Scales like fire and eyes of pure starlight. It sang to me, a song of hope and longing. It wants me to find it, I know it. I must be closing in."
%PARTY_4%

Technologies.Name: The Angler's Diary
Technologies.Subtitle: Collected Flotsam
Technologies.Description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"I was right! It was here! After all these light years, all the doubts, it's finally mine. Oh, and how it shines! Like fire in the water, beautiful, impossible..."
%PARTY_5%

Technologies.Name: The Angler's Diary
Technologies.Subtitle: Collected Flotsam
Technologies.Description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores.
It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free.
I must be free..."

Technologies.Name: Orbital Uplink
Technologies.Subtitle: Teleport Network Tunnel
Technologies.Description:
This device bypasses the mainstream teleport network, providing a direct link to the local Space Station.

Select the device and use Activate Teleport (FE_ALT1) to instantly transfer to the nearest Space Station.

Technologies.Name: Log of the Fireship Arcadia
Technologies.Subtitle: :: Datestamp 22516.01 ::
Technologies.Description:
SLASHLOG CORRUPT CLOCK RECOVERING DAMAGED SECTORSSLASH

"captain found a ::: on the last walk out
says it'll bring us luck
we'll need it, cruise has been a ::: waste so far
all the asteroids just dust and ice
::: nonsense but better than nothing"

Technologies.Name: Log of the Fireship Arcadia
Technologies.Subtitle: :: Datestamp 22518.24 ::
Technologies.Description:
SLASHLOG CORRUPT CLOCK RECOVERING DAMAGED SECTORSSLASH

"going from bad to worse
can't wait to get home
navigation ::: distorted ::: nothing but static
warping but ::: just empty systems
::: lost in some abandoned sector?"

Technologies.Name: Log of the Fireship Arcadia
Technologies.Subtitle: :: Datestamp 22522.31 ::
Technologies.Description:
SLASHLOG CORRUPT CLOCK RECOVERING DAMAGED SECTORSSLASH

"the captain ::: gone
tried to wake them for their watch
no sign of them ::: nothing on the cameras
door logs are normal, no kit missing
where are they?
where are we"

Technologies.Name: Log of the Fireship Arcadia
Technologies.Subtitle: :: Datestamp 22594.16 ::
Technologies.Description:
SLASHLOG CORRUPT CLOCK RECOVERING DAMAGED SECTORSSLASH

"we saw them
they ::: out the airlock
just ::: floating there
could hear them ::: singing
...
get us home ::: please"

Technologies.Name: Log of the Fireship Arcadia
Technologies.Subtitle: :: Datestamp 22512.64 ::
Technologies.Description:
SLASHLOG CORRUPT CLOCK RECOVERING DAMAGED SECTORSSLASH

"they all followed ::: the music
one by one ::: the lights called them
alone now
i hear the song now too, even when i ::: sleep
i'm so lonely ::: when will ::: when
help"

Technologies.Subtitle: Unfragmented Traveller Essence
Technologies.Description:
The final sputtering flame of a Traveller soul.

This is the echo of an unfragmented Traveller, with equal fragments of Royal, Sage, and Weaver.

It is an essential component of their signature.

Technologies.Subtitle: Lingering Soul Fragment
Technologies.Description:
A ghostly fragment of Traveller soul, lingering where it no longer belongs.

Data containing the weaver aspect of the Starship %SHIPNAME%'s previous owner.

Technologies.Name: Living Lens
Technologies.Subtitle: Chromatic Focuser
Technologies.Description:
Slotting seamlessly into a Traveller Exosuit, this glassy technology links a Traveller fragment to Specialist Polo's Prismatic Core, reforging the many into one.

Protects against annihilation by the Hive of Glass.

Technologies.Name: Pilot Signature
Technologies.Subtitle: Unfragmented Traveller Identification
Technologies.Description:
The final sputtering flame of a Traveller soul, bound in the remains of living creatures.

This identifying signature belonged to an intact, unfragmented Traveller, with equal fragments of Royal, Sage, and Weaver. It will unlock the Launch Thrusters of the starship %SHIPNAME%.

Technologies.Name: Void Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Living Curiosity
Technologies.Description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

Technologies.Name: Companion Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Viable Genetic Material
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A playful being wriggles and fidgets inside. The creature dreams of soaring aloft, with a Traveller companion to carry on planetary adventures.

Technologies.Name: Like-seed
Technologies.Subtitle: Window to a Dream
Technologies.Description:
A seed from another place. It crackles and hisses with static.

Everything you thought you knew is within.

Technologies.Subtitle: Portal Construction Blueprint Terminal
Technologies.Description:
The Utopia Overseers wish for their brave settlers to be sheltered and happy! Together, we will make Bakkin beautiful!

This officially-licensed portable research station allows access to a generous range of construction blueprints, easily purchased with the appropriate currency!

Construct and visit your own Utopia Build Station today!

Technologies.Description:
A Personal Surface Radar augmentation for the Multi-Tool. 

The Scanner releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any critical survival resources in the immediate area. Data is transmitted via the Exosuit directly into the user's visual nervous system.
 
Press SCAN to activate a local scan.

Technologies.Name: Analysis Visor
Technologies.Subtitle: Binocular Tagging Device
Technologies.Description:
Specialist Discovery and Survey unit.

Augments standard Scanner capabilities by projecting detailed environmental data directly over the user's visor. Allows the identification of distant points of interest.

The Visor will generate valuable data when used to study flora, fauna and minerals.

Hold AIM to operate. Press ZOOM to zoom.

Technologies.Name: Combat Scope
Technologies.Subtitle: Weapon Precision Enhancement
Technologies.Description: A recoil-stabilising weapon scope for precise combat.

Technologies.Name: Solar Vine
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
This 'living rock' is adapted to live in the extreme heat of scorched biomes. However, it can be farmed in most environments and, once established, yields a moderate harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Hot climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 16 hours

Technologies.Name: Scream Suppressor
Technologies.Subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
Technologies.Description:
This small extension to the ship's automated defense network appears to be its own autonomous organism. A small mouth in the centre of its flesh hungers for Pugneum.

During combat, it seems to hijack the neurological array and prevent fear or pain from traumatising the rest of the ship's body.

Technologies.Name: Harmonic Brain
Technologies.Subtitle: Harnessed Sentience
Technologies.Description:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry appears stable, pulsing with a regular electrical heartbeat. It no longer reacts angrily to my presence.

Status: DOCILE

Install this unit in a disabled Sentinel ship to unlock its vestigial cockpit and enable manual piloting.

Technologies.Name: Starshield Battery
Technologies.Subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
Technologies.Description:
A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems.
 
Tritium-fuelled capacitors provide quick-release charge for the Deflector Shield, but would overload smaller-scale equipment.

Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
Technologies.Description:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.

Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

Technologies.Name: Corroded Tanks
Technologies.Subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
Technologies.Description:
Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process.

Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

Technologies.Name: Photon Cannon
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Projectile Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A destructive starship projectile launcher, the weapons system of choice for the interstellar trader and pirate alike.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Spewing Vents
Technologies.Subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
Technologies.Description:
A mess of sacs and sphincters, these vents generate and expel globules of plasma. When fused to the weapon systems of the ship, these are super-heated and then expelled at high-pressure.

Press SHIPFIRE to ask if the ship would direct its vents towards the current target.

Technologies.Name: Sentinel Cannon
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentinel Ship Gun
Technologies.Description:
Sentinel-grade weapons system, engineered for the singular purpose of annihilating rogue ships in violation of system regulations.

Press SHIPFIRE to administer lethal force.

Technologies.Name: Pulse Engine
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Flight Booster
Technologies.Description:
Spaceflight propulsion, boosts and on-demand Pulse Jumps through local system.
 
User is advised that Tritium is required to charge Pulse Engine. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Locate Tritium with the starship scanner (SCAN).

Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Pulsing Heart
Technologies.Subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
Technologies.Description:
A fibrous metallic superstructure binds this warm and vital organ with the core of the ship. Without it, the ship would be nothing, a lifeless husk.

Hold PULSEJUMP to ask the heart to initiate a Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to request a speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Luminance Engine
Technologies.Subtitle: Repurposed Sub-Light Drive
Technologies.Description:
Aligns the ship's electromagnetic emissions with A T L A S waves, providing basic propulsion and Pulse Jump capability.
 
The sub-light drive hungers for tritium or radiant shards.

Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Waveform Engine
Technologies.Subtitle: Highly Customised Starship Engine
Technologies.Description:
A highly-tuned version of the conventional starship Pulse Engine. Wavefront occupancy has been pushed to the limit, creating a pulse experience that is both efficient and highly responsive.

User is advised that Tritium is required to charge the drive. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Scan (SHIPSCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.

Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

Technologies.Name: Phase Beam
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Energy Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A high-energy beam weapon for ship-to-ship combat. 

Though vulnerable to overheating, these highly accurate laser weapons can recharge the users's shields by leeching energy from target shield systems.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Grafted Eyes
Technologies.Subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
Technologies.Description:
A complex arrangement of membranes and lens, fused atop a high-energy laser array. Incineration awaits those that meet their stare.
Press SHIPFIRE request the eyes gaze upon nearby targets.

Technologies.Name: Infra-Knife Accelerator
Technologies.Subtitle: Rapid Fire Starship Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A rapid fire starship weapon that launches superheated globes of liquid metal at hostile targets. These projectiles are extremely effective against unshielded starship hulls.

Note: the Accelerator's internal components are vulnerable to rapid overheating. Sustained burst fire is not recommended.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Cyclotron Ballista
Technologies.Subtitle: Anti-Electronics Starship Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A powerful ship-to-ship weapon, flinging plasmatic balls of ionising radiation towards the selected target. These projectiles can disable starship engines, leaving the target vulnerable to attack from other weapons.

These charged particles are extremely effective against starship shields, and considerably weaker against the metal armour of a ship's hull.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Rocket Launcher
Technologies.Subtitle: Long Range Starship Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A long range starship weapon, capable of delivering a highly explosive torpedo across massive distances.

Note: explosive damage is highly effective against unshielded targets, but ineffective against shielded targets.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Wormhole Brain
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
Technologies.Description:
The wormhole brain permits the ship vision of systems far beyond its own experience.  It consists of strands of neural matter, wrapped around a micro-singularity and tethered directly to the ship's visual cortex.

Detailed economic and conflict data will become available on the Galaxy Map, should the ship permit it.

Technologies.Name: Conflict Scanner
Technologies.Subtitle: Long-range Sensor Technology
Technologies.Description: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access conflict data in the galaxy map, without having to put themselves in harm's way.

Technologies.Name: Economy Scanner
Technologies.Subtitle: Long-range Sensor Technology
Technologies.Description:
An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access detailed economic data about a system without having to visit. See collected data automatically on the Galaxy Map.

Active the scanner's internal Trade Computer with FE_ALT1 to search for highly-profitable trading surge events.

Technologies.Name: Deflector Shield
Technologies.Subtitle: Spacecraft Hull Protection
Technologies.Description:
Energy shield that protects spacecraft from laser fire, in-flight projectiles and accidental space debris interaction.

User is advised that catalytic elements are required to recharge device.

Operates automatically once constructed within user's starship inventory.

Technologies.Name: Aeron Shield
Technologies.Subtitle: Radiant Defensive Barrier
Technologies.Description:
A defensive crimson cocoon, obfuscating the ship's physical form and providing protection from collision and laser fire.

The core self-heals over time, but may be quickly replenished with catalytic elements or radiant shards.

Technologies.Name: Positron Ejector
Technologies.Subtitle: Close Range Starship Weapon
Technologies.Description:
A powerful starship weapon, capable of delivering extreme destruction at close range. 

Note: these particles show decreased effectiveness against shielded targets.

Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

Technologies.Name: Aeron Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

This engine modification injects the Starship exhaust trail with an arterial streak of crimson.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: A-class Reactor
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Core Component
Technologies.Description:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The advanced generator unit is capable of powering an A-Class starship.

Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

Technologies.Name: B-class Reactor
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Core Component
Technologies.Description:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The upgraded generator unit is capable of powering a B-Class starship.

Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

Technologies.Name: C-class Reactor
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Core Component
Technologies.Description:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The basic generator unit is capable of powering a C-Class starship.

Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

Technologies.Name: S-class Reactor
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Core Component
Technologies.Description:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The exceptional generator unit is capable of powering an S-Class starship.

Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

Technologies.Name: Stealth Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

Baryon suppressors alter the Pulse Engine's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Golden Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

Gold injection nozzles add a dazzling gold flair to the Pulse Engine's output.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Emeril Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

Emeril injection nozzles add a rich green flair to the Pulse Engine's output.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Storage Augmentation
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Expansion Module
Technologies.Description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a salvaged starship. May also be collected from freighter crash sites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Can be used to expand starship storage capacity at the Space Station's Starship Outfitter.

Technologies.Name: Pressurisation Capsule
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Life Support Unit
Technologies.Description:
A critical starship safety feature, vital for extra-orbital flight.

The pressuration capsule is a dedicated unit that both ensures a breathable atmosphere and prevents the catastrophic explosion of unconventional cockpit designs.

Technologies.Name: Sputtering Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Plasma Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

A visual enhancement for the starship, replacing traditional exhaust jets with a plasma thruster and generating a dramatic plume of ionised matter.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Chromatic Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Pulse Engine's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Cadmium Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

Cadmium injection nozzles add a bold red flair to the Pulse Engine's output.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Temporal Starship Trail
Technologies.Subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.

A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.

Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

Technologies.Name: Teleport Receiver
Technologies.Subtitle: Ship-Mounted Teleportation Device
Technologies.Description:
A device that modulates standard starship communication signals to enable the transport of matter as well as data.

Starships fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's exosuit over a long distance.

Technologies.Name: Scatter Blaster
Technologies.Subtitle: Scatter Shot Projectile Weapon
Technologies.Description:
Specialist close combat weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.

The Scatter Blaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to heat and shatter Metallic Elements, firing them in a wide cone of destruction. Range is limited, but the shrapnel is highly effective at close range.

Technologies.Name: Surge Battery
Technologies.Subtitle: High Voltage Energy Pack
Technologies.Description:
A high-powered battery pack, designed to release a significant charge in a short space of time.

Used to power the high energy needs of Signal Boosters as they survey planets for distant buildings.

Technologies.Name: Viral Heart
Technologies.Subtitle: Semi-Sentient Protein Strand
Technologies.Description:
A folded mass of pathogenic proteins, harvested from a deep-space biohazard.

This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Pathogen Sac
Technologies.Subtitle: Pulsating Biomass
Technologies.Description:
A glutinous fleshy lump, harvested from a deep-space biohazard. Ingestion is not recommended.

This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Technologies.Name: Pulse Spitter
Technologies.Subtitle: Rapid Fire Projectile Weapon
Technologies.Description:
Specialist rapid fire weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.

The Pulse Spitter redirects Multi-Tool optics to ionise inserted Metallic Elements. These projectiles are launched in a rapid-fire spread, bombarding potential targets with a wave of high-energy plasma.

Technologies.Name: Frostwort
Technologies.Subtitle: Plantable Seed
Technologies.Description:
A large crystal flower with radiant blue blooms, found only in snowy biomes. Frostwort can be farmed and makes a reliable crop, and its adaptation to harsh conditions results in highly frequent harvests.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Frozen climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 1 hour

Technologies.Name: Vesper Sail
Technologies.Subtitle: Advanced Engine Technology
Technologies.Description:
A high-performance solar sail, deployed automatically during flight. This advanced propulsion device generates an electric field within the sails themselves, allowing the starship to build momentum from the solar wind.

Offers substantial gains in fuel efficiency and boost performance over conventional engine systems, as well as enabling photovoltaic recharge of the starship's launch systems.

Technologies.Name: Animus Beam
Technologies.Subtitle: Soul Extractor
Technologies.Description:
A unique overload to the Multi-Tool's standard mining laser. Beam frequency is modulated precisely in a feedback loop with the delta-waves generated by the impact target.

Recordings of the target's experiences are thus etched into tiny fragments of metal and rendered as Fragmented Qualia. Readability of collected fragments is not guaranteed.

Technologies.Name: Sphere Creator
Technologies.Subtitle: Experimental Fabricator
Technologies.Description:
A highly-specific fabrication device, developed with the intention of finding the universe's most perfect sphere.

Requires power to operate. Will create a large sphere, ready for whatever experiments are deemed necessary.

Technologies.Name: Fearsome Visor
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Strike dread into the hearts of your foes with this oxide-strengthened helmet.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Broodling Skull
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this insectoid helmet represents the apex of bio-organic engineering.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Description:
A haunted Exosuit Appearance Override. Even once removed, the wearer will forever hear the whispering call of the deep ocean...
Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: MIND BLOWN
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu to share moments of existential wonder and delight with other explorers.

Technologies.Name: CELEBRATE!
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu to share moments of celebration with other explorers.

Technologies.Name: HA!
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu to share moments of amusement with other explorers.

Technologies.Name: WONDER
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu. Gaze up to large structures, fauna, flora, or the stars themselves, and marvel at the insignificance of one small life in all the universe.

Technologies.Name: NO PROBLEM
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu while underwater to signal 'no problem' to other aquatic explorers.

Technologies.Name: DISTANT GAZE
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu. Look to the horizon and search for your next adventure.

Technologies.Name: HEROIC POSE
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu. Strike a dramatic pose in front of abandoned structures, towering mineral formations, and colossal predatory lifeforms.

Technologies.Name: DISBELIEF
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu. Fall to your knees in disbelief at the wonders you have seen.

Technologies.Name: HOLOGRAM: BLOB
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.

This can be selected from the Quick Menu to generate a handheld hologram of an adorable miniature blob creature.

Technologies.Name: HOLOGRAM: FRIGATE
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:

This can be selected from the Quick Menu to generate a handheld hologram of a sleek and powerful frigate.

Technologies.Name: HOLOGRAM: STARSHIP
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:

This can be selected from the Quick Menu to generate a handheld hologram of a classic fighter starship.

Technologies.Name: HOLOGRAM: MULTI-TOOL
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.

This can be selected from the Quick Menu to generate a handheld hologram of a Multi-Tool pistol.

Technologies.Name: HOLOGRAM: SYSTEM
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.

This can be selected from the Quick Menu to generate a handheld hologram of a miniature solar system.

Technologies.Name: TOOT TOOT!
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gesture
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive gesture.
This can be selected from the Quick Menu. All aboard!

Technologies.Name: Iteration: Ariadne Visage
Technologies.Subtitle: Anomalous Face Transformation
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

This part silicone, part biological helmet can detect and replicate the facial muscle movements of the wearer, creating the appearance of a natural head. It is fully compatible with exosuit technology and provides all protection of a traditional helmet.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Description:

Transform the appearance of your fishing equipment from the fishing rig's bait management page.

Technologies.Name: Aeron Crab Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Shellseeker Companion
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

Laid by a soft-skinned crustacean, this species has evolved a synergistic relationship with Travellers, occupying the discarded shells of slain Sentinel Quadrupeds.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be shy and migratory.

Technologies.Name: Wandering Shrimp Tank Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Liquid-Suspended Consciousness
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch!

Part robotic, part organic, part liquid. The primitive anatomy of this creature's conscious organ belies a deep, calculating intelligence.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be focused and strategic.

Technologies.Name: Boundary Horror Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Spectral Anomaly
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

It wails, sleepless.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be haunting and adrift.

Technologies.Name: Corrupted Quad Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Sentinel Spawn Capsule
Technologies.Description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch!

The shell crackles with an electronic energy; mutated by Atlantideum, neutralised by [ redacted ].

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be tireless and gLaSs.

Technologies.Name: Geno-prawn Egg
Technologies.Subtitle: Abyssal Horror
Technologies.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

The serpentine foetus stares directly through the membrane of its egg. It watches. It waits.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be unblinking and slithering.

Technologies.Name: Rounded Laser
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This articulated mining laser is insulated with a lightweight gel, ensuring ultimate comfort for companions assisting with resource harvesting.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

Technologies.Name: Movement Tracker
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This compact device generates detailed analytics reports of creature traversal habits, to provide explorers with insight into the secret lives of their animal companions.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

Technologies.Name: Energy Coil
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This dual-purpose laser responds to the biological vitals of its wearer, providing an adaptive level of warmth and light, as well as soft pulses to soothe anxiety.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

Technologies.Name: Wayfarer's Helm
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Despite its aerodynamic appearance and advanced solar design, reliance on helmet-exclusive propulsion is not advised. For maximum safety, ensure all body parts are propelled equally.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Aeron Turbojet
Technologies.Subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A titanium flightpack, assembled from technology stolen from the Sentinel horde. Its engines are precooled with a constant flow of pugneum and nitrogen, ensuring fuel-efficient and deadly silent operation.

Warning: do not unseal pugneum containment chamber without protective gear.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Horrific Flesh-helmet
Technologies.Subtitle: Anomalous Face Transformation
Technologies.Description:
Naturally transform your appearance via the application of a flesh-hungry parasite. This living being partially fuses with the brainstem of its host, sealing their symbiosis.

Cautiously transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Armoured Shoulderpads
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Armour
Technologies.Description: Powerful shoulder armour, this Exosuit augmentation comes with high-voltage connections into the user's skeletal system. This current jolts the user's body as required, manipulating the muscles into their optimal defensive posture.

Technologies.Name: Armoured Boots
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Boots
Technologies.Description:
Reinforced foot protection system with integrated tread-balancing gyroscopes.

Hundreds of years of high-tech research, as applied to footwear.

Technologies.Name: Armoured Exogloves
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Gloves
Technologies.Description: Armoured gloves, perfect for wielding weapons, impressing martial cultures, and picking really spiky plants.

Technologies.Name: Armoured Leggings
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Leg Customisation
Technologies.Description:
Carefully woven nano-fibres make these leggings both flexible and resistant to small-arms fire.

Washing requires specialist equipment.

Technologies.Name: Armoured Chestpiece
Technologies.Subtitle: Unlockable Torso Customisation
Technologies.Description: Reinforced yet stylish, this Exosuit chest armour provides excellent abdominal protection without compromising on looks.

Technologies.Name: X.o. Suit
Technologies.Subtitle: Specialist Exosuit Visuals
Technologies.Description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Technologies.Name: Elixir of Glass
Technologies.Subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
Technologies.Description:
A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord.

The elixir will maintain your local boundary integrity and prevent the intrusion of the horrors beyond.

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 or inject it directly into the Anomaly Suppressor from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Technologies.Name: Anomaly Suppressor
Technologies.Subtitle: Automated Breach Integrity Device
Technologies.Description:
As the boundaries of reality begin to weaken, the risk of catastrophic breach anomalies increases.

This device monitors and maintains the local boundary strength, guarding against reality continuity errors. Supply the device with glass to maintain functionality.
